Globulation 2 — CLI 2

Generate a map at one exact seed

Usage: glob2 map generate GENERATOR [OPTIONS]

Options:

General:
  --seed <integer>
    Map seed (unsigned 32-bit) (default: 1) [0..4294967295]
  --set <assignment>
    Generator control KEY=VALUE; CLI overrides config [repeatable]
  --width <integer>
    Map width in tiles; registered values only [1..512]
  --height <integer>
    Map height in tiles; registered values only [1..512]
  --teams <integer>
    Number of colonies; registered values only [1..32]
  --workers <integer>
    Initial workers per colony; registered values only [0..2147483647]
  --config <file>
    KEY=VALUE configuration; CLI settings override it
  --map-image <file>
    Export categorical terrain PNG
  --export-generator-package <file>
    Export selected custom generator package
  --help
    Show this command's help (also -h) (default: false)

Outputs:
  --preview <file>
    Overview PNG output
  --preview-size <integer>
    Longest preview side in pixels [128..4096] [units: pixels]
  --preview-scale <2|4|8>
    Scale retained thumbnail pixels (default: 2)
  --output <file>
    Playable gzip map output; .gz is appended
  --report-file <file>
    Detailed map JSON report

Assets:
  --data-dir <directory>
    Add an asset search directory (in order) [repeatable]
  --generator-package <file>
    Load a custom generator package or directory [repeatable]

Constraints:
  Scalar options cannot repeat; switches and their --no- counterparts conflict.
  Use -- before positional filenames starting with '-'.
  At least one output is required
  Registered generator controls constrain tile sizes and values
  A failed layout never silently retries with another seed
  Choose at most one: --preview-scale --preview-size

Outputs: Requested .map.gz, overview PNG, categorical PNG and JSON report
Platform: all

Examples:
  glob2 map generate river --seed 713 --width 128 --height 128 --teams 2 --output artifacts/river.map --preview artifacts/river.png

Exit codes: 0 success/help; 2 invalid arguments or rejected input; 3 operational failure.

Globulation 2 — CLI 2

Usage: glob2 COMMAND [OPTIONS]
Run glob2 without arguments to launch the game. Supported launch URLs also work.

Commands:
  play  Launch the graphical game
  replay  Watch a recorded replay
  map generate  Generate a map at one exact seed
  map study  Run a structured map-generation study
  map generators  List generators or inspect controls
  map preview  Preview a map or save without stepping simulation
  map render  Render the complete game view
  map import-image  Import a categorical terrain PNG
  map export-image  Export categorical terrain and colony markers
  map inspect-package  Inspect and canonicalize a generator package
  map validate-set  Validate a terrain/resource set
  game run  Run or continue a structured headless game
  game repeat  Repeat a saved game headlessly
  match verify  Verify a multiplayer match record
  online join  Join an invite link or code
  online play-map  Play a catalog map locally
  online host-map  Host a catalog map online
  online turn-client  Play a relay assignment headlessly
  ai check  Validate JavaScript AI startup, metadata and callbacks
  script check  Compile a JavaScript map script
  script attach  Attach a JavaScript map script
  assets compose-buildings  Compose and validate building packages
  assets render-skin  Bake transparent colony sprites
  assets skin-info  Inspect native skin exporter capabilities
  dev random-games  Exercise random AI games
  dev stress-maps  Generate random maps indefinitely
  dev textshots  Capture rendered translation texts
  dev dump-resources  Dump map resource diagnostics
  dev dump-wheat  Dump AI wheat-protection plans
  dev dump-tiled  Dump a repeated map
  dev hive-worker  Internal Hive JSON-lines worker
  info version  Inspect the executable build
  info sim-version  Inspect the simulation identity
  info catalog  Inspect AI, generator and job capabilities
  info paths  Inspect asset search paths
  help  Describe commands without loading game assets
  completion  Print a shell completion script

Use glob2 COMMAND --help for complete options and examples.
Use glob2 help --format json for the machine-readable command tree.

Examples:
  glob2 play --window-size 1280x720
  glob2 map generators
  glob2 map generate river --seed 713 --output artifacts/river.map
  glob2 game run --help
